The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (5.45x39) is a [[Ammunition#Rifle cartridges|rifle cartridge]] used for [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbines]], [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifles]] and [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine guns]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.
